name: Consultation
summary: An hour in your garden with a designer, and a written list of what to do next.
includes:
A one-hour visit
Written recommendations
A plant list for your conditions

name: Garden design
summary: A full plan for your garden, drawn with you, ready for us or anyone else to build.
includes:
A site visit and measure
A scaled plan and planting list
Two rounds of changes

name: Garden care
summary: Regular visits, every week, fortnight or month, to keep the garden in shape.
includes:
Pruning and weeding
Feeding and mulching
Mowing and edging
